title: Seven cyclic fields with accelerated field arithmetic

claims.statement: The explicit 7-field degree-143 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-31 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 58259087342271339/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=8076852661303420208613024158017877909685412803949947105000260 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(1382315/6832).

experiments.purpose: Check QR profiles, field, orbits, work and the first three signed pair cutoffs (0), the remaining seven pair cutoffs (1), child noise shells and the early proper shells (2), and the full occupancy and error remainder (3). Part zero checks the equivalent cube schedule, fixed-cap work and new memory limit, with eight organizer-counter replays.
